$comment: A synthetic catalog for engine tests. Deliberately NOT the real rules/ directory: an engine test that depends on the domain catalog starts failing when a standard is reworded, which teaches people to edit tests when standards change. loadCatalog() takes a directory precisely so this can be separate.

rules.title: A rule the evaluator examines
rules.description: Stands in for an ordinary required rule with an implemented check.
rules.rationale: The engine's normal path needs a subject.
rules.$assuranceNote: Fixture. Establishes nothing about any real analysis.

rules.title: A rule nothing evaluates
rules.description: Stands in for a rule with no implemented check, to prove unknown never becomes a pass.
rules.rationale: The most important property in the system needs a subject.
rules.$assuranceNote: Fixture. Nothing evaluates this, by design.

rules.title: A non-exemptible prohibition
rules.description: Stands in for the fabrication prohibitions and integrity.no-weakening.

rules.title: A rule only a human can establish
rules.description: Stands in for prohibitions no scan can establish, such as fabricated market data.
rules.remediation: Have a person review it and record the judgement.
rules.$assuranceNote: Fixture. No automated check can establish this.

rules.title: A recommendation
rules.description: Stands in for what should normally be done.
